answer: The purpose of the AI Cyber Governance Module in the BSI Grundschutz framework is to describe the requirements for the secure implementation and use of AI services. It targets institutions that already use or intend to develop and deploy such services, focusing on essential aspects of AI governance, compliance, and monitoring. This module aims to link the requirements of the EU AI Act with the Grundschutz framework, ensuring that risks remain manageable for institutions and considering transparency dimensions that extend beyond the CISO's purview.
